body: The sharpest v1 complaint was 'no way to know which session really had any cookies stored'. Every row states cookie count, key count, saved-at and expiry; expanding shows cookie NAMES and storage KEYS, never values. Session labels seed from document.title at save time because real app titles already carry the user or tenant. Spec section 5.
title: Session state must be visible: signed-in / empty / expired / unknown
